findings.fix: Replace the alt with an accurate contextual description, for example “샘플의 현재 화면 해설. 오늘 다룰 내용이 순서대로 제시되었다는 설명과 0:12 시각이 보입니다.”
findings.evidence: alt="샘플의 현재 화면 해설과 설명을 들을 수 있는 조작 화면"; student-description.png contains no controls.

findings.summary: Step 4 omits the final analysis action from its text, leaving the screenshot as the only place that names the submission control.
findings.fix: After the prerequisites, add text explaining that configured users confirm rights and consent, then activate “선택한 자료 실제 분석”; explain the sample-only fallback without suggesting that a sample analyzes uploaded video.
findings.evidence: guardian-prepare.png shows “선택한 자료 실제 분석”; Step 4 prose stops at choosing inputs and explaining prerequisites.

passed: Each page has exactly one h1 and a logical h1 → h2 → h3 outline without skipped heading levels.
Both pages have unique descriptive titles and html lang="ko".
Both pages use a semantic header, one main, a page footer and a skip link to main.
The guide distinguishes its two navigation landmarks as “주 메뉴” and “가이드 단계”.
All 14 img occurrences have meaningful alt text; the 12 distinct referenced screenshots were visually inspected.
Decorative inline SVGs are hidden from assistive technology.
Screenshots use figure and figcaption, and guide image links describe opening the original-size screen.
Core sample preparation, student creation and assignment instructions appear in text outside the screenshots.
Sample screenshots are explicitly identified as prepared sample results, and the text states that no new video analysis occurred.
notes: Source and screenshot review only; actual screen-reader announcements and browser accessibility trees were not exercised.
guide.js was read only to confirm its enhancement preserves h2 headings and moves existing heading text into native buttons.
